examples.english: This is a beautiful day for their happy family.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: زَيْدٌ وَأَصْدِقَاؤُهُ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي الْحَيِّ الْجَمِيلِ.
examples.english: Zaid and his friends play in the beautiful neighborhood.
examples.transliteration: Zaidun wa asdiqaauhu yalabuuna fi al-hayyi al-jamiili.
examples.storyTitle: The Good Friends in the Neighborhood

examples.arabic: في المساء امشي في السوق الجميل واشم رائحة القهوة
examples.english: In the evening I walk in the beautiful market and smell the coffee.
examples.transliteration: fi al-masa amshi fi as-suq al-jamil wa-ashummu raihat al-qahwa.

examples.arabic: أنا أزورهم كثيرا وألاحظ دائما الانسجام الجميل بينهم.
examples.english: I visit them often and I always notice the beautiful harmony between them.
examples.transliteration: Ana azuruhum kathiran waulahidh daiman alinsijam aljamil baynahum.

examples.arabic: فرح الأطفال كثيرًا بتحديد موعد الرحلة إلى الشاطئ الجميل
examples.english: The children were very happy with setting the trip's time to the beautiful beach
examples.transliteration: Fariha al-atfal kathiran bi-tahdid maw'id al-rihlah ila ash-shati' al-jameel

examples.english: We sit in a beautiful and warm café
examples.transliteration: Najlisu fi maqhan jameelin wa dafi'in
